subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled structured editor dependency for Control UI raw config editing, and should the remaining work continue by rebuilding the open candidate or by asking for a fresh narrow PR?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it changes a sensitive config editing surface and adds a sizeable UI dependency, so automation should not choose the product/dependency direction by itself.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after a rebuilt or fresh PR targets current main, preserves reveal-to-edit/save semantics, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency and UX change until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter approach is chosen.

options.title: Ask for a short design note
options.body: Keep the issue open while a maintainer-reviewed note settles dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, and sensitive-value handling before code work continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after a rebuilt or fresh PR targets current main, preserves reveal-to-edit/save semantics, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied by history to the current raw config reveal-to-edit flow and recent Control UI config work that this feature must preserve.
